_note: House destruction (docs/house-destruction.md Contract 5). carve.by_source: carve radius in metres by blast source, else splash radius * default_share; 0 = no carve. materials: resist (1.0 = the radius as is, 0 = never carved; read in 1/16 units), weight and strength (load before a cell crumbles) per cell material. support: passes of detach + load, span_cells (0 = off). fracture: Voronoi pieces of a fallen part. debris: the client's cosmetic debris; rubble fade|stay (/rubble overrides it for the round).
